title: What Is ElevenAgents? Build Your First AI Voice Agent with ElevenLabs
desc:
ElevenLabs tutorial: What Is ElevenAgents? Build Your First AI Voice Agent with ElevenLabs.

ElevenAgents coordinates speech to text, a language model, text to speech and a turn-taking model into one voice agent. This episode covers the architecture, the configure, deploy and monitor lifecycle, the building blocks, the four ways to manage agents, the dashboard quickstart with the example prompt, evaluation criteria and data collection, and the same agent built with Python, the CLI and the website widget.

This episode is a documented walkthrough built from the official ElevenLabs documentation (links below). It does not include a live product recording.
